hashConvention: snapshotSha256 hashes raw captured Windows bytes. snapshotNormalizedLfSha256 replaces CRLF with LF without changing JSON content, so Git-normalized clones can reproduce it. Raw snapshots are retained unchanged.

distinctions.advisoryVsEntry: Nine distinct GHSA records; npm package entries include propagated electron-vite findings and are a different count.
distinctions.cacheRecord: EXA-68 GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp retains audit-range removal; upstream-disputed report. No code-level security fix or proven Bug Pocket exploit is claimed; historical snapshots are untouched.

distinctions.approval: No self-granted security exceptions. EXA-70 remains In Progress pending independent final review and maintainer approval.
